name: Denial spike investigation
purpose: Investigate a denial-rate change and separate operational loss, payer changes and coding risk.
checks: Reconcile payer/product, service line, claim population and periods; compare counts before rates.
Segment CARC/RARC and first-pass versus final denials; distinguish unique claims from transactions.
Test policy, registration, authorization, coding and interface hypotheses against dated evidence.
Prioritize deadline exposure; draft an owner-led recovery plan and verify improvement on a later cohort.
evidence: Aligned baseline/current claims and denied counts
Actual denied dollars; contract, policy and appeal status
decisions: Revenue cycle owner validates cohorts and loss assumptions.
Coding/compliance owner reviews coding hypotheses; contracting owner verifies payer policy.
Authorized operator reviews any submission and verifies resulting receipt.
completion_gate: Verified cohorts, named owners, tested root cause and a monitored follow-up; a calculated rate is only an intermediate result.
source_policy: Keep the original aggregate report or approved source extract with its effective date. A source-family card is a lookup lead until exact text is verified.
